evidence.reason: Replaced the single unchecked fs.writeSync in the unit-switch fixture with a loop that writes the full byte-encoded completion record and, if the write stalls or errors, truncates the completions file back to its original length before failing, so no partial JSON line is ever left for the next run's readSequence; tests were not run because the harness permits only git commands.
